prog='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            if grid[r][c] == 2:
                refs = (
                    (r, n - 1 - c),
                    (n - 1 - r, c),
                    (n - 1 - r, n - 1 - c),
                    (c, r),
                    (n - 1 - c, n - 1 - r),
                    (c, n - 1 - r),
                    (n - 1 - c, r),
                )
                for a, b in refs:
                    if grid[a][b] != 2:
                        out[r][c] = grid[a][b]
                        break
    return out
'''
